correctness.rationale: The exact three-dimensional vector field and the source’s quasi-static quadratic were checked in the primary full text. At n>1 and gamma>0 the fast block is strictly Hurwitz; the only local center mode is the infection coordinate and the invariant x=0 plane is the strong-stable manifold. Exact cubic-order invariance calculations give K=gamma(n-1)/n and E=gamma(n-1)(n-2)/n^2. Independent quadratic-root expansion gives E_qs=gamma(n-1)(n-3)/(2n^2). Positive cubic damping gives local attraction and a rigorous scalar inversion yields the claimed two-term limits, their difference 1/(4gamma), and the degree-5/2 sign reversal. The included exact symbolic checker passed after extraction/preparation; SciPy computations were used only as nonproof diagnostics. Scope is explicitly local and deterministic.

value.rationale: The 2026 source motivates quasi-static elimination by the fast/slow distinction and proves its usefulness for epidemic thresholds. At the unusual rewiring-degeneracy point, even the leading universal critical decay matches, masking a quantitative timing defect; the theorem isolates a nonvanishing exactly universal degree-independent t^-1 bias and a counterintuitive sign reversal for 2<n<3. Such an error estimate identifies the precise order at which macroscopic reduction ceases to reproduce physical-time clearance, beyond a generic cubic-critical example. It is a motivated approximation-boundary result, not a trivial substitution or an arbitrary parameter table.
